about: An application opens the platform's Settings at a page (docs/adr/0019-settings.mdx), as a Mac's application opens x-apple.systempreferences: React Native's Linking opens oxyos-settings://about, which the application asks of the session from its window, citing the press; the session opens it in Settings, whose entry declares the scheme, and Linking resolves. A URL no application's entry declares the scheme of (https://example.com: OxyOS has no browser) is asked of the session too (protocol version 33, docs/adr/0058-the-platform-api.mdx, step 6), which opens nothing, and Linking rejects, saying so. With the compositor refusing an application's OpenUrl, the Settings step closes the application's connection and fails.

steps.name: Open the web first: refused, saying why; nothing is opened

texts_matching: ^refused: OxyOS did not open https://example.com: no application opened it

steps.name: Open Settings: the session opens oxyos-settings://about in Settings, at its About page, and Linking resolves
